name: IO校准诊断
description: Oracle IO Calibration（DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.CALIBRATE_IO）评估存储子系统的 IOPS、吞吐量和延迟。结果存储在 DBA_RSRC_IO_CALIBRATE，供优化器做 cost 估算（如判断全表扫描 vs 索引扫描的 IO 成本）。未校准时优化器使用默认值可能导致次优计划选择。

conditions.desc: 从未执行过 IO 校准

skip_when.desc: IO 校准已在过去 30 天内执行

root_causes.name: 从未执行 IO 校准
root_causes.desc: 数据库部署后从未运行 CALIBRATE_IO。优化器使用默认 IO 性能假设，可能导致计划选择不准确。

root_causes.name: 校准结果过期
root_causes.desc: 存储环境变化（更换磁盘、调整 RAID 级别、迁移到 SSD）后未重新校准。

root_causes.name: 校准在高负载时执行结果不准
root_causes.desc: 校准应在低负载时执行以获得准确的基线性能。高负载时的校准结果偏低。

step1_check_calibration.sql: SELECT max_iops, max_mbps, max_pmbps, latency, num_physical_disks, start_time, end_time FROM dba_rsrc_io_calibrate

step2_run_calibration.desc: 执行 IO 校准（低峰期）
step2_run_calibration.sql:
SET SERVEROUTPUT ON
DECLARE l_latency PLS_INTEGER; l_iops PLS_INTEGER; l_mbps PLS_INTEGER; BEGIN DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.CALIBRATE_IO(num_physical_disks => &disk_count, max_latency => 20, max_iops => l_iops, max_mbps => l_mbps, actual_latency => l_latency); DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('IOPS:' || l_iops || ' MBPS:' || l_mbps || ' Latency:' || l_latency || 'ms'); END;

step3_io_performance_check.desc: 快速检查当前 IO 性能
step3_io_performance_check.sql: SELECT event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000, 2) avg_wait_ms FROM v$system_event WHERE event IN ('db file sequential read', 'db file scattered read') ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC
